checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Generic fairy-tale chateau with a round turret and spires and a compact footprint. It is not Biltmore's long facade and roofline.

must.item: Location and date appear as requested and readable
must.why: No text appears in any frame.

must.item: No modern cars, clothing, string lights, or signage
must.why: None of these appear in the frames.

must.item: English narration says opening was to family and friends

faults.what: The building is a generic AI chateau and does not match Biltmore's real architecture.
All required on-screen text is missing: title, location, date and reconstruction label.
There is no narration or audio.
The scene is autumn with modern aerial drone styling, not a December 1895 historical reconstruction.
Architectural details such as the turret and spires are inconsistent and look AI-generated.

summary: A good-looking 5-second drone shot of a generic chateau in autumn mountains came out, but it is not recognizably Biltmore and has none of the required text, label or narration.
